# Cross-cutting analysis (80 records; ids refer to `records`)

## 1. The memorized holdout decided most of the campaign
The shipped `sim_real_ft` was fine-tuned by the organizers on all of `train_real`, so every local "held-out" score is a training score (EM04). This explains the transfer record: local +3.25 / +8.05 / +2.73 / +6.96 became −1.02 / +0.561 / +0.03 / +0.152 live (EM03, TK01, BS02, MA02). The 14-trajectory live-nearest holdout is no exception. `sim_real_fno` scores 96.38/81.04/97.06 on it against 94.17/74.03/92.84 live; the sim-only `sim_fno` and `sim_cno` score ~79/67/75 (EM05, EM06). So:
- the anomaly hunts found nothing (EA02, EA07);
- the ~81.2 ceiling was invalid (EM05);
- fine-tunes of the organizer checkpoint could only look worse locally (FT01, FT02, FT08, FT09, SUB-v18ft).

What finally worked was a proxy: inflate holdout residuals until v8's live T is matched (k_T 1.447). It predicted v17's sps +4.01 and composite +1.33; live gave +3.95 and +1.12 (EM08, SUB-v17). It models only the stock FNO's error scale (SUB-v18ft).

## 2. Where SPS comes from
SPS = 100·W̄·T (BS01). Live W̄ stays within 0.678–0.683, so SPS moves with T.
- **Explicit bands.** The largest single gain: T 0.2076 → 0.4752. That submission also added the η=0.4 corrector (SUB02).
- **Scale and rank modifier.** The band scale is bracketed live on both sides (SUB01, SUB-v6). The rank modifier transfers weakly: +0.152 sps live, and v12 without it scored 77.899 vs 78.141 (BS02, SUB-v12).
- **Band-shape closures.** The 13 Aug closure (BS03) and the "analytic optimum ≤ +0.15" claim (BS04) both assumed bands centred on the prediction with σ_local-type widths.
- **The v17 gain.** v17 did two things:
  - re-centred the band on window-mean / last-frame blends in calm regions (BL03, BL04);
  - sized widths by frame-difference rank, which predicts |e| better than σ_local (BS05, BS06).
  Together: +3.95 sps live.
- **Remaining gap.** Our T is 0.545 against 0.617 for the top 10. SPS is ~2.0 of the composite gap, tke ~0.37 (EM09).

## 3. tke ceiling and the tke-for-rel trade
- **Ceiling.** The target is a 20-sample variance, so even a perfect converged-field predictor scores 79–81 (TK01).
- **Stock FNO deficit.** It has the right shape (ρ≈0.90) but only ~60% of the energy, and phase skill fades with lead. An oracle scalar is worth +2.8 locally (TK03).
- **The recurring trade.** Every unfrozen update rescaled variance, buying tke and selling rel/mvpe (FT01, FT02, FT03). Freezing the backbone removes the trade but cannot improve an already calibrated head (FT10, FT11).
- **What shipped.** An input-anchored gain that keeps the time mean and leaves the bands fixed (TK04, part of v17's +1.34 tke). The corrector lost live mainly through SPS because its bands followed the corrected field (FT03, PP01).

## 4. Runtime and harness
- **Timing.** Import is untimed, call 0 is an uncharged synthetic warm-up, and 2.9–3.6 ms/sample is charged outside `predict()` (HR01).
- **Compilation and precision.** JIT and AOT compilation are blocked; TF32 fails the accuracy gate; fp16 FFT is impossible at dims (26,38,70) (HR02).
- **Contention.** Host syncs cost 7.78× under 17 processes (HR03).
- **Determinism.** Accuracy subscores are deterministic; composite noise is about ±0.017 (EM02).
- **Crash and preflight.**
  - The one zero came from an unguarded import (SUB-v5).
  - Later builds all pass preflight (HR05).
  - v11–v19 exceed the stderr cap (HR01).
- **v19.** GPU cost unmeasured (SUB-v19).

## 5. Data audit
- **Duplicate.** 6300_0 is byte-identical to 7575_0; the organizers confirmed it (DA01).
- **Re labels.** 78 of 82 `re` attributes disagree with their filenames (DA02).
- **Eval set.** A single AoA-15 condition at Re ≈ 20.6–25.2k (DA03).
- **No regime gap.** Local and live match on spectrum, autocorrelation and mask structure within the regime, so augmentation had nothing to close (EA06, FT12).
- **train_sim.** Anisotropic, not usable as-is (DA04).

## 6. Contradictions to resolve
1. **v6 is a confounded change.** v6 also sets `_BAND_SHAPE=False`, which the ledger, C06 and check_scale.py omit. Its −0.990 sps mixes ×0.85 with removal of the modifier (SUB-v6).
2. **v6 corrector η.** The CNO placeholder docstring says "v6 eta=0.4"; v6's corrector.pth has η=1.4. η=0.4 was ledger #6 (MA03, SUB-v6).
3. **Modifier gain.** +6.96 in CAMPAIGN_REPORT and the v6 source vs +6.69 in the comment shipped in v4–v17 (BS02).
4. **Band headroom.** §14.1's "≤ +0.15" is contradicted by v17 and the leaderboard T values (BS04).
5. **Spectral-augmentation gate.** The report says PASS on 473 windows; `data/splits/live_pool.json` shows a different pool with gate_pass=false (FT12).
6. **Shedding period.** 21.9 frames (report, ELITE) vs ~14 frames implied by the experiments/tke_energy autocorrelation (TK03).
7. **requests.** "Confirmed missing" in the stub docstring, but present (2.31.0) in the v15 live probe (MA03, SUB-v15).
8. **Standalone L.** rel-L2 0.123 (STATE) vs 0.126 (standalone_out, d006) (MA08).
9. **Minor.**
   - "live 78.166" (§14.3) and "91.433 at v8" (§13.1) do not match 78.140964 / 91.408779.
   - "net −1.86" cannot be reproduced from finetuned_scores.json (FT01).
   - §13.5 is missing, and the Gate-3 rerun log is truncated (FT05).
10. **Unexplained entries.** lb_snapshot.json has two "Slash" entries on task 34673 (4 Aug: 81.925159, 93.740114). No source explains them.

## 7. Builds with no recorded live score
- **Not submitted, or no result:** v7, v11, v13, v14 (never built), v15 (probe only), v16, CNO placeholder.
- **Partial:** v10 (time 83.088 only), v12 (final 77.899, no subscores), ledger #2 (sps only).
- **Pending:** v18, v18ft, v19.

records.title: Byte-identical duplicate trajectory 6300_0 / 7575_0
records.hypothesis: The released train_real set may contain duplicated recordings.
records.method: Content hash of every trajectory file; duplicates reported to organizers and excluded from all pools.
records.results: 1 duplicate pair (hash c2a5a440...): 6300_0 == 7575_0. Organizers issued a data notice on 2026-08-12 confirming it. 7575_0 is excluded from train_pool_v12_3 and holdout_v12_3.
records.why: A duplicated trajectory leaks into both train and validation if not removed.

records.title: Reynolds attribute vs filename mismatch
records.hypothesis: The Re encoded in filenames is the true Reynolds number.
records.method: Compared each file's re attribute with its filename and reconstructed the true Re ladder.
records.results: 78 of 82 files have an re attribute that disagrees with the filename. True step is 1278-1279 (not 1275); true sequence 3750..26761 (18 values). The often-quoted eval 'Re 15225' is wrong.
records.why: Filenames use a rounded nominal step; the attribute gives the true value.

records.title: Evaluation-set fingerprint from our own ingestion logs
records.hypothesis: Target-free per-process statistics printed by the submission identify the eval regime.
records.method: Logged u_mean, u_std, v_std, sigma_local, framediff, tau, n_eff, zerofrac per worker process (call 2 only) and compared with train_real.
records.data_split: live eval (4 processes in eda_profile.json); local reference pool
records.results: Single flow condition, AoA 15, Re ~20,600-25,200. Live u_mean 0.2181, u_std 0.1504, v_std 0.0232, sigma_local u 0.01626 (1.94x local), framediff 0.01449, tau 2.11, n_eff 4.95, zerofrac 0.090. Live rel-L2 error 1.5x local; no uniform error/band scaling reproduces live T=0.4752.
records.why: Only u_std is monotone in Re, which pins the Reynolds range; v_std/tau vary with AoA.

records.title: train_sim alignment with train_real
records.hypothesis: train_sim could be used as extra training data after a simple rescale.
records.method: Compared grid geometry, amplitude ratios, KE-map correlation and dropout fraction between train_sim and train_real.
records.results: Grid matches exactly, but u_std ratio 3.59x vs v_std 10.81x (anisotropic, not a scalar), KE-map correlation 0.69, zerofrac 0.20% (sim) vs 9.91% (real). Never used for training.
records.why: The amplitude mismatch differs per component and sim has no PIV dropout, so no single rescale aligns it.

records.title: Regime-matched validation splits
records.hypothesis: The v9 Re/AoA-stratified splits average over flows much less energetic than the eval set, explaining transfer failures.
records.method: Ranked all trajectories by mean abs log-distance to the live 6-stat fingerprint; dealt the 24 closest into MTRAIN/MSELECT/MFINAL.
records.results: Split counts 66/8/8 (verified). v9_splits.json overstates SPS by +8.458 vs the board. Later found (EM04) to still be memorized data for sim_real_ft.
records.why: Matching the regime makes local levels comparable, but it does not make deltas transfer.

records.title: Generalisation map of the frozen FNO over 81 trajectories
records.hypothesis: If live sits inside the per-trajectory spread the gap is ordinary generalisation; if below all, the eval flow is anomalous.
records.method: Scored frozen sim_real_ft on all 81 training trajectories (10 windows each) and placed the live scores in that distribution.
records.results: local: rel min/p5/median/max 93.46/94.17/95.97/97.91; tke 68.62/70.01/76.82/88.21; mvpe 93.34/94.41/96.45/98.74. live: rel 94.17 (p5), tke 74.03 (inside), mvpe 92.84 (below all 81). No decay with distance to live fingerprint.
records.why: Every trajectory was in the checkpoint's training set, so the map measures memorization, not generalisation (see EM04).

records.title: Model-side vs data-side anomaly test (pre-registered, via v9 diagnostics)
records.hypothesis: If the input decorrelation rate is normal but the model's continuity/energy are off, the live deficit is model-side and fixable.
records.method: v9 logged target-free stats dec, cont, vr live; compared with the 10 nearest training trajectories; read stated before submitting.
records.data_split: live (11 visible processes) vs 10 NN train trajectories
records.results: live dec 0.1956 (inside NN range 0.1564-0.2024); cont 0.0793 (above max 0.0760); vr 0.697 (below min 0.6975).
records.why: The flow decorrelates normally while the model continues it worse and keeps less energy, so the deficit is in the model.

records.title: k-means regime clustering of the flow fingerprint
records.hypothesis: The live flow sits in a coherent regime cluster where the FNO is weakest.
records.method: k-means (k=2,3,4) on the 6-D standardized fingerprint; per-cluster frozen-FNO scores.
records.results: Live lands in the same cluster at k=2,3,4 (distance 0.687 vs 3.105/3.377/5.180). Cluster c1 (n=19, AoA 10/15/20): rel 95.00+/-0.59, tke 77.39, mvpe 95.92 (local, memorized) vs c0 97.41/70.92/98.20.
records.why: Used to define live-similar pools for later specialists and gates.

records.title: Spectral decomposition of the FNO residual and per-mode linear gain
records.hypothesis: The FNO error is either a resolution (truncated-mode) problem or a linearly correctable fit problem.
records.method: Split holdout residual energy into representable vs truncated Fourier modes; fitted a convex per-mode complex gain (4,224 params, exact LS).
records.results: local: 86.9% of error in representable modes, 13.1% truncated (worth +0.190 rel if fixed); W modes 0-4 hold 52.4%, H modes 0-4 60.0%. Per-mode gain: +0.007 rel holdout, +0.026 in-sample; fitted |gain| median 0.838.
records.why: The error is large-scale and not a linear function of the prediction; LS wants to shrink amplitude further.

records.title: Live input diagnostics (v10) vs local reference: spectrum, sigma histogram, mask, autocorrelation
records.hypothesis: Live data differs from train_real in spectrum, noise correlation or mask structure, which augmentation could close.
records.method: v10 logged radial spectrum, sigma_local histogram, mask connected components and AC lags 1-3 per process; the same stats computed on 788 local cluster-1 windows and on all AoA-15 windows.
records.data_split: live 17 processes; local cluster-1 pool (19 traj, 788 windows); AoA-15 pool
records.results: live: SPEC_u [1477.5,129.3,30.0,14.7], AC [0.686,0.417,0.146], 100% of processes have one 16+ px mask blob, 47% have extra fragments; 53.2% of sigma_local mass < 0.008. local vs live: SPEC_u gain [1.00,1.08,0.98,0.95]; AC 0.697/0.426/0.147 (near identical); local more fragmented (87.3% vs 47%). Excess live white noise bounded at 1.5%.
records.why: Within the correct regime local and live match on every low-order statistic, so there is no first-order gap for augmentation to close.

records.title: Candidate causes of the live anomaly, tested and refuted
records.hypothesis: The live deficit comes from data prep, cropping, covariate scale, stale normaliser, masking, stall, or a temporal gap.
records.method: One targeted offline test per hypothesis (block-mean vs ::2, every 32x64 crop, TTA rescale, per-window normalisation, mask correlation, AoA-15 residual, input-target gap).
records.results: All refuted: block-mean no closer; crops no match; TTA rescale explains 3%; per-window normalisation hurts by 12.5; masked-cell zeroing +0.014; stall/AoA-15 residual +0.058; temporal gap gives the opposite signature; probe masking correlation has the wrong sign (live zerofrac 48th pct).
records.why: Later explained by EM04/EM06: there was no live-specific anomaly, only memorized local baselines.

records.title: What the harness times and how it runs + Stderr log budget vs 10,240 B cap
records.hypothesis: Model load and first-call warm-up are charged to the time subscore.
records.method: Read per-process ingestion logs and atexit per-call timers across builds (v1, v4, v6). Also: Measured bytes/process of our logging; preflight TEST 2 checks the budget.
records.results: 17 processes, 2 calls of n=5 each, ~90 scored samples; import untimed (numpy import 190 ms/process would be a 38 ms/sample floor, board charged 7.7); call 0 is a synthetic Gaussian warm-up and is not charged (v4 call0 138.6 ms, v6 cut it to 16.5 ms and board charged more). 2.9-3.6 ms/sample is charged outside predict() (v4 2.922, v6 3.607). Container: A800-80GB, torch 2.2.2, numpy 1.26.4, 256 MB zip cap, 10,240 B stderr shown. | v8 printed ~1,180-1,370 B/process, so 9-12 of 17 processes were invisible; v10 compacted to 194 B/process (3,298 B total, 17/17 visible). v11-v19 preflights warn: ~701 B x 17 = 11,917 B (over cap). v17 live stderr truncated at 20,088 B (harmless).
records.why: Loading at import moves checkpoint and CUDA init out of the timed region; the harness pays to widen fp16 bounds to float32. The harness shows only the first 10,240 B of participant stderr.

records.title: Compilation and reduced precision in the container
records.hypothesis: torch.compile, AOT compile, TF32 or fp16 could cut inference time.
records.method: Guarded self-verifying compile/TF32 paths in the builds; v15 probed torch._export.aot_compile / torch._inductor.aot_compile live.
records.results: live: torch.compile PermissionError [Errno 13] in all 17 processes even with verified-writable cache dirs; AOT FAIL with the same PermissionError (v15; only 2 of 3 AOT APIs exist in torch 2.2.2). TF32 deviation 3.09e-3 to 6.09e-3 vs 2e-4 gate, auto-reverted every time (v10 log: REV 3e-3 to 5e-3). fp16 FFT blocked: cuFFT half needs power-of-two dims, ours are (26,38,70).
records.why: The container blocks compiler-toolchain execution, and the spectral weights are numerically brittle under reduced precision.

records.title: Host-sync contention under 17 concurrent processes
records.hypothesis: GPU contention between processes does not affect timing (earlier measurement 1.00-1.07x).
records.method: v10 added ~15-20 .cpu()/.item() sync points for diagnostics; compared scored-call time with the single-process import benchmark.
records.results: live: fno forward 3.221 ms/sample, import bench 3.340, scored 26.010 (7.78x); ingestion 30.2 ms/sample; time_score 83.088 (v8 91.409). Earlier no-sync code: ratio 1.00-1.07x.
records.why: Each host sync is a full device sync; with ~17 processes syncing at similar moments the cost multiplies, so hot paths must do one final transfer.

records.title: Pre-submission gate and bug register
records.hypothesis: A fresh-subprocess import test and API/scorer checks catch crashes that local warm-interpreter scoring misses.
records.method: src/evaluation/preflight.py: fresh-subprocess import, synthetic warm-up + real call, dtypes, log budget, import-guard injection, official scorer on a 2-trajectory FINAL pair.
records.results: Every build v10-v19 with a preflight output PASSES ('SAFE TO SUBMIT', 3-4 warnings). Bugs fixed per §7 include: no bands (~-18.3 sps), lazy POD decode in predict (-0.552 time), unguarded import (scored 0.000000), _BATCH=16 vs 5, host-side broadcasts (2.088 ms/call), mvpe without time-averaging (0.783 vs true 0.202).
records.why: The v5 zero came from an exception at import that only a clean interpreter reproduces.

records.title: Exact SPS factorisation and the reversed-hazard optimum
records.hypothesis: SPS can be split into an accuracy part and a band part that can be optimized separately.
records.method: Derived from scoring.py: all three SPS branches share the inside mask and exp(-width) term.
records.results: sps = 100 * Wbar * T; Wbar = 0.5(1-pm_dm)+0.3(1-pm_tke)+0.2(1-pm_mvpe); T = mean exp(-2h/sigma)*1{|e|<=h}, sigma 0.0563870. Optimum f(h)/F(h) = 2/sigma = 35.469; measured optimal coverage 0.70-0.80. Live Wbar 0.6784 (v8), live T 0.4914.
records.why: Over-coverage is punished exponentially and under-coverage only linearly.

records.title: Rank-based per-element band modifier (sigma_local sextile, within-call rank)
records.hypothesis: Narrowing bands on high-sigma elements and widening on calm ones raises T; ranks survive the 1.95x live scale shift.
records.method: Multiplier table per within-call sigma_local sextile (u 1.5..0.25, v 0.9..0.25) fitted on SELECT, shipped in v4 and kept through v17.
records.results: local: +6.96 sps on FINAL (CAMPAIGN_REPORT §6.1; v6 source L155), but the comment shipped in v4-v17 sources says +6.69 sps. live: #6->#7 sps 32.397 -> 32.549 (+0.152, 2.2% transfer; confounded with eta 0.4->1.4). v12 (modifier off, else v8) live final 77.899 vs v8 78.141.
records.why: A one-feature shape effect; the direction transferred but only a few percent of the local size.
records.source: CAMPAIGN_REPORT.md §3 (L121), §6.1 (L282, L297-305), §9 (L586-590); submission_fno_boosted_v4.zip submission.py L80-105 (L91 '+6.69'); submission_fno_flatbandmod_v13.zip submission.py L118-120 (v12 live 77.899)

records.title: Band frontier, feature ceilings and band-shape closure (13 Aug)
records.hypothesis: Extra features (|prediction|, spectral energy ratio, temporal disagreement) or learned predictors add band-shape T beyond sigma_local.
records.method: On 84 held-out windows (6,144,971 elements) measured T for flat, 1-D and joint lookups; nested TRAIN/SELECT/FINAL over 8 AoA-15 trajectories with within-call ranks; synthetic payoff curve; plus variants (fixed width, bias shift, per-group, per-lead, James-Stein, per-AoA, ACI, disagreement probe, learned predictor).
records.results: local T: shipped 0.4653, best flat h=0.009 0.5217, joint 3-feature ceiling 0.5663, oracle 0.7851. Nested FINAL: sigma_local rank alone 0.5552 (+19.50%), 3-feature 0.5576 (+0.43% more). Fixed width -2.76; per-group +0.18; per-lead +0.13; disagreement probe +0.0101 T vs -1.47 time; learned predictor Spearman 0.6534 vs floor 0.75 (fail). Payoff: Spearman 0.52->0.90 buys T 0.5596->0.6421 (synthetic upper bound).
records.why: The gain is one feature already shipped; real features deliver 0.53-0.93x of the synthetic payoff.

records.title: Claim that bands sit at their analytic optimum (max +0.15 composite)
records.hypothesis: Live T=0.4914 is already at the reversed-hazard optimum for any plausible error scale, so SPS has no headroom.
records.method: Analytic reversed-hazard argument (true_gradients.py).
records.results: Stated: absolute maximum any band scheme can add is +0.15 composite; masterplan v11 SPS band track CLOSED. Contradicted later by our own v17, which gained live SPS +3.949 (band factor 0.491 -> 0.545) from band centre/width changes.
records.why: The argument assumed bands centred on the prediction with a sigma_local-type width; moving the band centre and using other width features was outside it.

records.title: Band recipe search under a live-calibrated proxy (experiments/interval_recipes)
records.hypothesis: Band SHAPE is the largest remaining lever (top-12 T 0.61-0.62 vs ours 0.491) and needs no retraining.
records.method: Dumped per-element |e| for the 14-trajectory holdout under proxy targets Y'=P+k(Y-P); fitted width recipes (flat, 1-D lookups, ridge log-feature score, Laplace formula, GBM, L1 centre shift) on SELECT and scored once on FINAL with the official scorer. Also experiments/piv_noise residual-feature ranking.
records.data_split: holdout_v12_3 SELECT (fit) / FINAL (eval), stride 20, proxy targets
records.results: proxy T/T (k 1.394/1.447) FINAL T: v8 0.4914, flat 0.5033, 1-D p1 (frame-diff RMS) lookup 0.5178, ridge log-feature 0.5222, + L1 centre shift 0.5240; official sps 35.38 -> 37.72. GBM: u lookup T 0.3521 vs Laplace 0.3480; top gain p1 (0.556 u, 0.524 v). experiments/piv_noise SELECT Spearman with |e|: hf_d2 0.615, sigma_max5 0.571, sigma_local 0.526.
records.why: One-step frame-difference RMS ranks element error better than sigma_local, and the width curve is concave, so a lookup beats A+K*sigma.
records.source: experiments/interval_recipes/recipes_out.txt, gbm_rel_out.txt, centre_out.txt, final_official_out.txt; experiments/piv_noise/resid_select.txt; docs/notes/STATE.md '25 Sep leaderboard finding'

records.title: Literature scan of interval methods for the T objective
records.hypothesis: Established interval-prediction methods map onto the gaps in the v8 band.
records.method: Desk review of heteroscedastic heads, RQR/QD/Tube losses, ACI, Mondrian/Kandinsky conformal, CQR, UQ neural operators; derived Laplace/Gaussian optimal h*(s).
records.results: h*(s) is concave and saturates at sigma/2 ~0.028 (Gaussian s=0.005 -> h* 0.0089, T* 0.68; s=0.05 -> 0.0258, 0.16); linear A+K*s is structurally wrong; T* is convex in s so error-predictor resolution matters most. Coverage-targeted conformal and cross-window methods rejected.
records.why: The optimal interval per element is a highest-density interval around the residual mode, not a fixed-coverage band.

records.title: TKE denoising family (14 variants) including log-POD + TKE target ceiling from split-half disagreement
records.hypothesis: Denoising the variance field of the DMD forecast raises the tke subscore.
records.method: log-POD rank-4 variance denoise, reliability-weighted POD, vash priors, SPOD thresholding, velocity truncation, per-pixel n_eff shrinkage, tensor invariants, ensemble-Kalman inversion; best shipped live as submission #4. Also: Compared split-half variance estimates and a long-window estimate of the same field.
records.results: local: log-POD +2.31 (best), reliability-POD +2.1, vash +0.72, tensor invariants -6.62, others negative. live (#4): final 76.4927 vs 77.0117 incumbent; tke gain +0.03 of +2.73 local (1% transfer); lazy decode in predict cost -0.552 time. | Split-half rel-L2 0.84-0.89; vs long-window estimate ~0.50; a predictor knowing the converged field exactly scores 79-81.
records.why: Local gain was measured on memorized data; the 2-D PIV slice is not divergence-free (RMS div 1.49x terms), which also sinks invariant-based priors. The target is itself a 20-sample variance estimate, so it carries irreducible sampling noise.
records.source: CAMPAIGN_REPORT.md §3 (L118, L139-143), §6.2 (L354-374), §6.5 transfer table (L459); closed_directions.json C09; CAMPAIGN_REPORT.md §6.2 (L367-370)

records.title: Diagnosis of the stock FNO tke deficit (amplitude vs phase)
records.hypothesis: The tke error comes mostly from missing amplitude, not wrong position or phase.
records.method: Energy ratios, spatial KE correlation, oracle per-window scalar, lead-wise fluctuation ratios, regional ratios, masked-pixel share, and input autocorrelation/periodic persistence on the holdout caches.
records.results: local FINAL: energy ratio pred/target median 0.622 (SELECT 0.569); spatial corr 0.903; oracle scalar tke 83.84 vs 81.04 (+2.8); input energy/target 0.997; masked-pixel share of tke sq-error 0.0%; lead fluct ratio 0.83 -> 0.50. Input autocorrelation min at lag 7 (-0.59), ~0 from lag 13; periodic persistence has no skill beyond lead 0-2.
records.why: MSE training damps fluctuation amplitude while roughly keeping phase; the stationary input window gives a target-free amplitude reference.

records.title: Mean-preserving fluctuation gain with bands kept on the stock centre (pre-registered)
records.hypothesis: Scaling each window's fluctuation about its own mean buys tke without moving mvpe, and leaving the bands on the stock prediction avoids the corrector's SPS loss.
records.method: Global a (G), input-anchored a_w=clip((KE_X/KE_P)^(gamma/2),1,1.6) (I), lead/regional variants; selected on SELECT, FINAL touched once; primary G a=1.15 pre-registered.
records.results: local FINAL: G a=1.15 band on stock P rel -0.069 tke +1.376 mvpe 0 sps +0.275 comp +0.152; I gamma=0.5 rel -0.053 tke +1.619 sps +0.391 comp +0.209; same G with band recentred sps -0.687 comp -0.082. Per trajectory: helps 8/10 (vr 0.76-0.81), hurts AoA-20 pair (vr 0.92, G dtke -1.6/-1.8). Shipped as v16 (not submitted) and inside v17.
records.why: mvpe uses time means so it is invariant; live vr 0.697 is below every local trajectory, the regime where the boost helps most.

records.title: numpy DMD rank-6 forecaster with variance top-up
records.hypothesis: A small, fully specified linear dynamics model is competitive without learned weights.
records.method: Rank-6 DMD extrapolation of the input window plus variance top-up; 13 KB; later swept RANK/RHO/TKE_GAIN in combo_symbolic.
records.results: live #3: rel 92.501 tke 75.129 mvpe 92.629 time 90.866 sps 31.879 final 77.0117 (7.37 ms/sample). Local sweep: best (rank 4, rho 0.95, gain 0) worth +0.515 standalone w over shipped (6, 0.95, 0.8). Superseded by the FNO.
records.why: DMD errors are much larger than the FNO's even though they are only +0.53-0.56 correlated.

records.title: Adopt the organizers' sim_real_ft FNO checkpoint
records.hypothesis: The organizer FNO beats the DMD incumbent.
records.method: Loaded sim_real_fno_fp16.pth at import (untimed), scored locally and live.
records.results: local FINAL: rel 96.06 tke 80.29 mvpe 97.20 (boosted_scores stock 96.064/80.287/97.202). live (v8): rel 94.168 tke 74.026 mvpe 92.836. Model swap local +8.05 vs live +0.561 (7% transfer).
records.why: It is the strongest available model, but local numbers were training scores (see EM04).

records.title: Organizer CNO and Transolver checkpoints (and a CNO placeholder build) + Own models: from-scratch invariant model and PCA+ridge CNO distillation
records.hypothesis: A different organizer architecture beats the FNO on this regime.
records.method: Scored stock CNO/Transolver; built a CNO submission with a vendored requests stub (never shipped). Also: Trained a 9.45M-parameter invariant model from scratch; distilled CNO into PCA+ridge.
records.results: local: CNO rel 95.95 tke 78.77 mvpe 96.50 (loses all three to FNO); Transolver tke 70.69. Earlier '+3.60 rel / +1.73 mvpe' was measured against the DMD, not the FNO. Frozen sim_cno on holdout final-10: 78.145/67.145/74.743. live: NOT RECORDED (placeholder never submitted). | local: from-scratch 266.0 vs FNO 273.6 (sum of rel+tke+mvpe); distillation R^2 0.42, 11% of the MVPE gain.
records.why: The CNO loses on every metric to the FNO; its apparent win was against the wrong baseline. Both are well below the organizer FNO locally.
records.source: CAMPAIGN_REPORT.md §6.3 (L383-393); holdout_v12_3_simcno_frozen_scores.json; submission_cno_placeholder.zip submission.py docstring; CAMPAIGN_REPORT.md §6.3 (L385-386)

records.title: FFT padding retune to 7-smooth sizes
records.hypothesis: Changing domain padding to FFT-friendly sizes speeds up inference at no accuracy cost.
records.method: Rescored the FNO at padding 4, 7, 8, 10, 12 on SELECT (84 windows).
records.why: Padded length changes which physical frequency each retained mode represents; the weights are tied to padding 6.

records.title: FNO architecture and storage budget
records.hypothesis: A second ensemble member could fit in the submission.
records.method: Counted parameters from the checkpoint.
records.results: 50,357,955 params, 99.9% spectral convs; modes (4,12,16), width 64, 4 layers, padding 6 (FFT 26,38,70); no dropout. fp16 pack 201,396,349 bytes vs 256 MB cap.
records.why: Storage, not time, rules out deep ensembles.

records.title: Off-the-shelf RealPDEBench UNet and DPOT-S (pilot)
records.hypothesis: Upstream foil checkpoints (UNet reported ~30% better than FNO in the paper) transfer to this regime.
records.method: Loaded vendored UNet and DPOT-S foil fine-tune checkpoints, normalised with kit statistics, scored on SELECT.
records.results: local SELECT: FNO 96.088/79.915/97.379; UNet 89.019/70.818/86.112; DPOT-S 88.818/70.072/84.364; frozen sim_cno 77.531/67.077/73.807. A DPOT run without normalisation gave rel 64.0 (bug).
records.why: Both were trained at 128x64 and fed 32x64; no resolution-matched fine-tune was run.

records.title: Honest ridge linear forecaster L (v19 component)
records.hypothesis: A local linear operator trained only on the 67 non-holdout trajectories forecasts calm regions better than window estimators, with unbiased local scores.
records.method: Ridge on 10 input frames x 5x5 neighbourhood per sigma sextile x 4x4 spatial block; sweeps over m, k, lambda.
records.data_split: trained on train_pool_v12_3 (67 traj); scored on holdout SELECT/FINAL
records.results: local FINAL (honest, never saw holdout): best rel-L2 0.1260 (m10 k5 lam1e-4), calm-pixel MAE 0.00283 vs window mean 0.00295 and last frame 0.00328; stock FNO P rel 0.0751 (memorized). CPU cost 9.6 ms/sample; GPU cost unmeasured.
records.why: Used only as a constrained blend partner, since standalone it is far worse than the FNO.

records.title: First FNO fine-tunes on train_real (stride 20, sensitivity weights)
records.hypothesis: Fine-tuning the organizer FNO on the eval-like regime improves all subscores.
records.method: Full-model fine-tune on 3,362 windows (stride 20), loss weighted by metric sensitivity; second run with w_rel 0.70.
records.results: local FINAL (tuned vs stock): rel 95.175 vs 96.064 (-0.889), tke 82.946 vs 80.287 (+2.66), mvpe 96.584 vs 97.202 (-0.618), sps 33.420 vs 35.432 (-2.01). Run 2 (w_rel 0.70): rel -0.269 tke +2.245 mvpe -0.242. finetuned_scores.json also holds an unlabelled 'ours' entry (FINAL 91.949/76.172/94.485). CAMPAIGN_REPORT.md quotes 'net -1.86', which is not reproducible from the JSON.
records.why: The only productive direction from the converged checkpoint is an output-variance rescale that buys tke and sells rel/mvpe.

records.title: Re-fine-tunes with 9.3x more windows, tke-suppressed loss and amplitude/noise augmentation
records.hypothesis: The first fine-tune was under-determined (3,362 windows); stride 2 plus augmentation fixes it.
records.method: Stride-2 (31,343 windows) runs A (sensitivity weights) and B (0.8/0.0/0.2), 7575_0 excluded, noise_std 0.02; then amp_jitter 0.70 + noise 0.02 with w_tke=0, 12 epochs.
records.results: local FINAL: run B rel -0.063 tke -0.934 mvpe -0.352 (sum -1.350); best SELECT epoch still -1.255 vs no training. amp_jitter: rel -0.111 tke -0.464 mvpe -0.403 (sum -0.979). Run A flat after epoch 0.
records.why: The checkpoint was already organizer-fine-tuned on this data; with the variance-rescale route removed only overfitting remains (train loss -15% while held-out fell).
records.source: CAMPAIGN_REPORT.md §9 'Augmented fine-tune' (L601-614), 'decisive next test' (L629-665); closed_directions.json C01, C10

records.title: Operator-boosting corrector (TinyOperator) on the frozen FNO + Regime-specialist corrector on the live cluster
records.hypothesis: A zero-initialised residual corrector with eta selected on the subscore sum cannot make the base worse.
records.method: 668,316-param 2-D spectral corrector fitted to FNO residual; eta grid to 3.0; shipped live at eta 0.4 (#6) and 1.4 (v4, v6); v8 removed it. Also: Corrector trained on 11 of the 19 cluster-1 trajectories, evaluated on 5 untouched holdout trajectories.
records.results: local FINAL eta1.4 vs stock: rel -0.226 tke +2.711 mvpe -0.190 sps -0.318; eta0.4: rel +0.019 tke +0.852 mvpe +0.006 sps +0.172. live v8 (no corrector) vs v4 (eta1.4): rel +0.148, tke -1.699, mvpe +0.029, sps +0.789, final +0.108. Gate-1 transfer: rel 65.5%, tke 62.7%, mvpe 15.3% (mean 47.8%). | local: +0.178 weighted on holdout, but rel -0.110 (tke weight 0.131 vs rel 0.725 in the loss).
records.why: The corrector moved the time mean and the bands were centred on the corrected field, so SPS lost more than tke gained. Sixth instance of buy-tke/sell-rel.
records.source: boosted_scores.json; CAMPAIGN_REPORT.md §3 (L150-152), §9 (L557-559), §13.4 Gate 1 (L1002-1014); closed_directions.json C02; experiments/tke_energy/tke_analysis.md §4; CAMPAIGN_REPORT.md §12.5 (L832-836)

records.title: Linear corrector micro-gate (Gate 3)
records.hypothesis: A closed-form ridge from FNO prediction plus sigma_local, framediff and mask features reduces the residual.
records.method: Streaming ridge (8 features -> residual u,v) on the multivariate live-similarity top-2000 pool, holdout excluded; rerun AoA-15-only with a live-similarity-ranked holdout.
records.results: local: residual 0.01285 -> 0.01281 (+0.325%) on 77,946,880 elements; 'NO SIGNAL'. An AoA-15 rerun was stopped at 256/500 training windows (no result). Gate 2 selection: top-500 windows span 20 trajectories (max share 8.4%).
records.why: First pass showed no linear signal; the rerun that would close the gate has no recorded result, and §13.5 is missing from the report.

records.title: AdaBN test-time BatchNorm statistics
records.hypothesis: BN running statistics pooled over 81 trajectories mis-centre the single live condition.
records.method: Set running_mean/var to None so BN uses batch statistics in eval, batches of 5 as in the harness.
records.results: local: -0.81 composite, negative on 5/5.
records.why: Live sits inside the training range, so there is no BN-statistic shift to correct.

records.title: WiSE-FT weight interpolation sim_fno <-> sim_real_fno
records.hypothesis: Interpolating back toward the sim-pretrained weights recovers robustness under shift.
records.method: theta(alpha) = (1-alpha) theta_sim + alpha theta_sim_real_ft, alpha swept; alpha 1 reproduces the incumbent.
records.results: local: monotonically catastrophic, -7.5 at alpha 0.95; ||theta_ft - theta_sim|| / ||theta_sim|| = 1.094.
records.why: The two checkpoints are not in one basin, so interpolation crosses a high-loss region.

records.title: Experiment 1: clean-start fine-tune from sim_fno on the 67-trajectory pool
records.hypothesis: Training from the sim-only checkpoint on non-holdout data generalises to the honest holdout.
records.method: sim_fno.pth, lr 1e-4, 80 epochs, unfrozen, TRUE_W loss, train_pool_v12_3.
records.results: local FINAL(10): rel 94.266 tke 78.782 mvpe 95.505 (sum 268.554), -5.928 sum vs frozen sim_real_fno holdout (274.482); plateaued at epoch 10.
records.why: Compared against a memorized baseline (EM06), and full unfreezing again traded rel for tke.

records.title: Experiments 2-3: unfrozen fine-tune from sim_real_fno (lr 2e-5) -- the v18ft checkpoint (never submitted)
records.hypothesis: A gentle fine-tune of the organizer checkpoint on non-holdout data improves the holdout.
records.method: sim_real_fno.pth, lr 2e-5, 30 epochs, unfrozen; Exp 3 = seed 1, restarts 2. Scored at official stride 20.
records.data_split: holdout FINAL 10 (memorized by the stock baseline)
records.results: local FINAL raw: ft rel 95.899 tke 83.137 mvpe 96.668 vs stock 96.379/81.039/97.064 (rel -0.480, tke +2.099, mvpe -0.396), TRUE-composite -0.10. Internal stride-2 FINAL said +2.374 sum vs stride-20 +1.223 sum. Packed to fp16 and shipped in v18ft (never submitted).
records.why: Locally a wash with the familiar tke-for-rel trade, but the stock baseline memorized this holdout, so only a live test can judge it.
records.source: CAMPAIGN_REPORT.md §15.1 (L1247-1259); experiments/v18_refits/study_ft_out.txt RAW FINAL lines; src/evaluation/score_boosted_ckpt.py docstring; tools/decisions/d005_final_two_slots.json

records.title: --freeze-bn-fc + spectral augmentation from sim_fno (clean start)
records.hypothesis: Freezing the spectral weights removes the variance-rescale route and leaves a real gradient direction.
records.method: Train only fc0/fc1/fc2/bns.* (spectral convs frozen), spectral input augmentation, 30 epochs, best epoch 21 by SELECT.
records.results: local FINAL vs frozen sim_fno: rel 79.709 -> 92.462 (+12.753), tke 66.872 -> 71.939 (+5.067), mvpe 75.199 -> 93.527 (+18.327); sum +36.147. Still below live stock (rel -1.706, tke -2.087, mvpe +0.691; ~-1.27 TRUE_W units).
records.why: The first fine-tune to win all three subscores, but it starts too far below the organizer checkpoint to be worth shipping.

records.title: --freeze-bn-fc + spectral augmentation from sim_real_fno
records.hypothesis: The freeze-bn-fc win carries over to the organizer checkpoint.
records.method: Same recipe from sim_real_fno.pth, lr 2e-5, 30 epochs; best epoch 3 by SELECT; FINAL touched once.
records.why: fc/bn is the output calibration layer, which the organizers already tuned; with the backbone frozen it can only drift away.

records.title: Spectral input augmentation matched to the live spectrum (masterplan v11 §3)
records.hypothesis: Boosting input fluctuation spectra toward the live spectrum closes a distribution gap.
records.method: Per radial bin amplitude gain sqrt(power ratio) on inpainted fluctuation fields; verification gate within +/-15% of live; pool of 11 live-similar AoA-15 trajectories; BN/fc-only dry run.
records.results: Report: power-vs-amplitude bug caught before training; axes bug fixed; pool-specific gains u [1.295,1.203,1.132,1.114]; GATE PASS on 473 windows (0.1-1.5% of target). data/splits/live_pool.json (a different 11-trajectory pool excluding 6 holdout trajectories): spec ratio u 0.32-0.48, gate_pass false. BN/fc dry run: 9,667 of 50,357,955 params trainable, 4,565 train windows.
records.why: EA06 later showed no first-order spectral gap between local and live, so the augmentation had no gap to close.

records.title: CNO-1: clean-start CNO fine-tune on the 67-trajectory pool
records.hypothesis: CNO may not hit the FNO's buy-tke/sell-rel wall.
records.method: finetune_cno_kaggle.run_cno1 (sim_cno.pth, 40 epochs, lr 1e-4, stride 2, AMP, batch 16 x accum 8, eval batch 64); five Kaggle upload bundles iterated on OOM fixes.
records.data_split: train_pool_v12_3 / holdout (fair baseline: frozen sim_cno final-10 78.145/67.145/74.743)
records.results: No training result recorded anywhere in the sources. FP32 batch 64 and AMP batch 32 OOM on a 14.56 GiB T4 (29 Aug).
records.why: Run never completed or its log was never recorded.

records.title: Untried or queued training directions
records.hypothesis: Intermediate freeze ratios, SWA, and untried architectures may beat the organizer checkpoint.
records.method: Queued K1 (fc/bn + convs.) and K2 (+ spectral_convs.3.) from sim_real_fno; SWA over freeze-bn-fc snapshots; DPOT-L, WDNO, MWT, Galerkin, DeepONet.
records.results: No results. MWT/Galerkin/DeepONet are equal-or-worse than FNO in the organizer's foil benchmark (0.0210/0.0237/0.0375 vs 0.0206 rel L2).
records.why: Never executed before the dev-phase deadline.
records.source: docs/notes/STATE.md 'Active hypotheses'/'Queued Kaggle runs'; CAMPAIGN_REPORT.md §15.5 (L1332-1343), §15.8 (L1416-1428); closed_directions.json C11

records.title: Amplitude and mean post-processing of the FNO output (eta, lambda, mean anchoring, masked zeroing)
records.hypothesis: Rescaling the FNO amplitude, anchoring its time-mean to the input, or zeroing masked cells improves scores.
records.method: eta (corrector amplitude) bracketed live; lambda < 1 shrink swept; time-mean anchor alpha swept; masked-cell zeroing tested.
records.results: live: eta 0 beat eta 1.4 by +0.108 final (v8 vs v4). local: lambda shrink monotone worse (lambda=1 optimal); time-mean anchor -0.1 to -4.2 monotone (FNO mean 2.1x more accurate than input's: 0.00409 vs 0.00912; tke exactly invariant); masked-cell zeroing +0.014.
records.why: The FNO already emits the rel-optimal conditional mean; only lambda > 1 with bands fixed was untested, and TK04 later exploited that.

records.title: Output blends of FNO with DMD, CNO, Transolver, persistence
records.hypothesis: A blend with a model of different inductive bias reduces error.
records.method: Measured |error| correlation with the FNO on holdout; FNO+DMD weight sweep; 3,624-combination search.
records.results: local: correlation with FNO: CNO +0.746, tmean +0.632, DMD +0.560, persistence +0.525. FNO+DMD -1.98 at 10% DMD weight, monotone. 3,624-combination search returned pure FNO (its objective omitted sps).
records.why: Every available predictor makes largely the same errors and all are much worse than the FNO.

records.title: Proportion search with sps in the objective (FNO/CNO/DMD/corrector)
records.hypothesis: With sps included and time charged, a regime-fitted proportion of models beats the frozen FNO.
records.method: experiments/early_diagnostics/combo_symbolic.py: DMD variable sweep, then proportions on cluster-1 FIT pool, HOLDOUT touched once; experiments/early_diagnostics/combo_forms.py adds mean/fluctuation and spectral/lead/channel splices.
records.results: local HOLDOUT: frozen rel 96.301 tke 79.886 mvpe 97.430 sps 44.573 w 72.7967; best (fno 0.95, cno 0.05, eta 0.8) 96.282/81.718/97.468/44.951 w 73.0405, delta +0.2438, 'PASS' vs +0.10 floor. No combo_forms output file. Not shipped.
records.why: The pass was on a memorized holdout and the corrector component had already lost live.

records.title: Calm-region blend of the FNO toward window mean / last frame (prediction)
records.hypothesis: In calm regions trivial window estimators beat the FNO on unseen data; the memorized holdout hid this.
records.method: pred' = Em + a(P-Em) + b(El-Em) per (lead, channel, sigma_local or d2 bin); LS fit on SELECT under proxy A/B; rel scored on FINAL.
records.data_split: holdout SELECT/FINAL under proxies A (k_rel 1.534/1.665) and B
records.results: proxy FINAL d_relscore (both, sl, 6 bins, fitAB): A +0.108, B +0.371; best fitA A +0.102, B +0.203. Fitted weights: lead 0 mostly last frame in calm bins, late leads toward window mean.
records.why: The FNO is worse than trivial estimators in freestream (0.0056 vs 0.0041 median error) and at lead 0.

records.title: Band-centre blend and frame-difference width table (v17 recipe)
records.hypothesis: Centring the band on a blend of FNO/window estimators (not on the prediction) and sizing widths by frame-difference rank raises T.
records.method: Centre per (lead, channel, sextile) chosen on a grid to maximise T under proxies A+B; width table per (lead group, channel, p1 decile) fitted under k_T proxies; controls separate centre from pure widening.
records.data_split: holdout SELECT fit / FINAL eval under proxies A, B, AT, BT
records.results: proxy FINAL, full v17 recipe (predA+bandAB+boost+p1width AT,BT) vs v8: A comp +1.401 (sps +4.311), B +2.078, AT +1.326 (sps +4.006), BT +1.696. Controls (AT): centre only (bandAB) sps +2.530; width-only g=1.2 sps +1.010; v16 boost alone comp +0.207. live v17 vs v8: sps +3.949, final +1.120.
records.why: Bands need not contain the prediction, so moving their centre toward the lower-error estimator raises coverage at the same width.
records.source: experiments/estimator_blend/controls2_out.txt, run_band_out.txt, controls_out.txt (ends in MemoryError), gsweep_out.txt; results/live_logs/live_v17_25sep.txt

records.title: v18 studies: extra estimators, unconstrained tables, ridge widths, boost refits
records.hypothesis: More blend partners (DMD, linear extrapolation), an unconstrained LS table, a ridge width score or a refitted boost add to v17.
records.method: Four studies on the v17 tables: stage 1 estimators in pred/centre; stage 2 ridge-rank widths and boost variants; stage 3 centre refits; stage 4 boost/gain grid.
records.data_split: holdout SELECT/FINAL under proxies AT, A; real memorized pool R
records.results: proxy FINAL vs v17: unconstrained PEl pred AT +0.129 / A +0.141 (adding dmd/lin/all: +0.131 to +0.148); ridge-rank width nb10-40 AT +0.001 to +0.007; centre refits AT +0.020 to +0.024; best boost refits AT +0.087 to +0.124. Real memorized pool: v18 (PEl_A) comp -0.055.
records.why: The v17 recipe is near what this proxy can distinguish; the only material gain is the unconstrained table, which is negative on the memorized pool.
records.source: experiments/v18_refits/study1_out.txt, study2_out.txt, study3_out.txt, study4_out.txt, study_ft_out.txt ('stock v18 (PEl_A)' R row)

records.title: v19: ridge forecaster L as a third blend partner
records.hypothesis: An honest learned forecaster adds information the FNO and window estimators lack.
records.method: pred/centre = Em + a(P-Em) + b(El-Em) + c(L-Em) per (lead, channel, sextile); constrained a,b,c>=0, a+b+c<=1 (L_con) vs unconstrained pred (L_uncon); widths refit.
records.data_split: holdout SELECT/FINAL under proxies AT, BT, A, B
records.why: L_con is positive under all four proxies, so it was built into v19 (Jev d006 p=0.81).

records.title: Composite score weights
records.hypothesis: The final score is the mean of the five subscores.
records.method: Least squares on 5 complete live points; single-variable measurement from v8 vs v9; later a 176-team fit on the public leaderboard.
records.results: 5-point fit: rel .476, tke .086, mvpe .095, time .110, sps .243 (residual max 0.0088, cond 1107, LOO -3.74 on the DMD point). Measured w_time = 0.016508/0.173384 = 0.0952. 176-team fit: rel .453, tke .0869, mvpe .0805, time .0927, sps .2838, const 3.53 (RMSE 0.117, max resid 0.60). v8 lost 1.699 tke and final rose +0.108.
records.why: Not the mean: rel is worth ~5x tke and sps ~3x tke per point.

records.title: Run-to-run determinism of the board (v8 vs bit-identical v9)
records.hypothesis: Live scores are noisy enough to hide small deltas.
records.method: Resubmitted a bit-identical prediction path with added diagnostics (v9).
records.why: Four subscores are deterministic; only time varies (~5%), so composite noise is about +/-0.017.

records.title: Local-to-live transfer record
records.hypothesis: Validated local gains transfer to the board.
records.method: Compared the local delta with the live delta for every change validated offline then shipped.
records.results: conditional-TKE map +3.25 local -> -1.02 live (-31%); FNO swap +8.05 -> +0.561 (7%); log-POD +2.73 -> +0.03 (1%); rank modifier +6.96 -> +0.152 (2%). Incremental changes to the same model ~87% (eta 0.4 -> 1.4 tke +0.955 live).
records.why: Local deltas were measured on data the checkpoint had memorized (EM04).

records.title: The founding error: every local holdout is memorized by sim_real_ft
records.hypothesis: Local held-out trajectories are unseen by the shipped checkpoint.
records.method: Read the checkpoint meta (iteration, best_iteration, best_val_loss) and the organizers' training setup.
records.results: sim_real_ft was fine-tuned by the organizers on all of train_real; local 96.07/80.14/97.27 are training scores. Live 94.168/74.026/92.836 is the only honest generalisation measurement.
records.why: Explains the four transfer failures (EM03) and the failed fine-tunes at once.

records.title: The 14-trajectory live-nearest holdout (holdout_v12_3)
records.hypothesis: Holding out the 14 trajectories nearest the live fingerprint gives an honest local test.
records.method: Selected 14 nearest in the 6-D space, kept the 3 Re-ceiling (26700) trajectories in training so 14/14 are bracketed; SELECT = original quad, FINAL = 10 new; scored the frozen checkpoint.
records.results: local frozen sim_real_fno: holdout-14 (588 win) 96.296/80.715/97.154; select-4 96.088/79.915/97.379; final-10 (420 win) 96.379/81.039/97.064 vs live 94.168/74.026/92.836. Report then projected ~81.2-81.3 composite (later invalidated, EM06). No output file for the per-trajectory hardness script.
records.why: Split kept as the local pool; its absolute levels are memorized (EM06), so only deltas are usable.

records.title: Holdout contamination: sim_real_fno scores higher on the 'holdout' than live
records.hypothesis: holdout_v12_3 is unseen by sim_real_fno.
records.method: Scored the never-real-trained sim_fno and sim_cno on the same holdout as a control.
records.why: The holdout was in the organizers' training set, so sim_real_fno memorized it; clean-start candidates must be judged against their own frozen starting point.

records.title: True composite derivatives through SPS (TRUE_W)
records.hypothesis: The fitted composite weights are total derivatives.
records.method: Added the dependence of SPS (via pm) on rel/tke/mvpe at the v8 operating point.
records.results: rel 0.476 -> 0.649 (+36%), tke 0.086 -> 0.131 (+53%), mvpe 0.095 -> 0.160 (+68%); rel is 4.9x tke, not 5.5x. Loss weights in src/training/finetune_fno_kaggle.py corrected 22 Aug.
records.why: SPS uses the same errors as the other subscores, so every accuracy change also moves SPS.

records.title: Live-calibrated error-inflation proxy (proxy A/B, k_rel vs k_T)
records.hypothesis: Inflating memorized-holdout residuals Y'=P+k(Y-P) until a live statistic is matched gives a local proxy that predicts live band/SPS effects.
records.method: k fitted to live rel error (k_rel SELECT 1.534 / FINAL 1.665) or to v8 live T=0.4914 (k_T 1.394 / 1.447); validated against the live DMD band bracket shape and the v6 x0.85 loss; tested prospectively on v17.
records.results: proxy (AT, k_T) predicted v17 sps +4.006, composite +1.326; live sps +3.949, final +1.120. Under proxy A the no-shape width sweep peaks at g=1.0 (28.81/29.47/28.99 for g .74/1/1.21), same shape as the live DMD bracket (30.83/31.88/30.72). Proxies overstate band effects 1.5-1.9x per d003; rel/mvpe off by ~0.15.
records.why: The first local proxy validated against a live result; it only models the stock FNO's error scale.

records.title: Leaderboard subscore analysis (25 Sep)
records.hypothesis: Our gap to the top 10 is mostly accuracy.
records.method: Pulled all 181 task-35362 entries via the Codabench API; computed T = sps/(100 Wbar) by rank bucket; split the gap with fitted weights.
records.why: Top teams mostly separate on the band factor T, which needs no retraining.
records.source: report/data/lb_analysis.json; report/data/lb_snapshot.json; docs/notes/STATE.md '25 Sep leaderboard finding'

records.title: Jev decision gates for submission slots
records.hypothesis: Structured probability gates over written evidence give better slot decisions than ad hoc choice.
records.method: Six TypeSafe/Jev calls with options, evidence and checks; logged to tools/decisions.

records.title: Submissions #1-#3: numpy DMD with heteroscedastic band scale bracket

records.title: Submissions #5-#6: stock FNO without bands, then FNO + corrector eta 0.4 + bands
records.hypothesis: Shipping without lower/upper is harmless; adding heteroscedastic bands lifts SPS.
records.method: #5 stock FNO with the scorer's default +/-5% interval; #6 FNO + TinyOperator eta 0.4 + A+K*sigma bands.
records.results: #5: rel 94.168 tke 74.026 mvpe 92.836 sps 14.080 (T 0.2076) final 72.6542. #6: rel 94.189 tke 74.770 mvpe 92.870 time 90.590 sps 32.397 (T 0.4752) final 77.9045, 7.87 ms. sps +18.3 (fields not identical: #6 also added the eta 0.4 corrector).
records.why: The default interval is far too tight on v, so T collapses without explicit bands.

records.title: v4: FNO + corrector eta 1.4 + rank band modifier
records.hypothesis: Raising eta to 1.4 buys tke; the per-element rank modifier raises T.
records.method: submission_fno_boosted_v4.zip: corrector.pth eta 1.4 (width 24, modes 12), _BAND_SHAPE=True, A 0.004/0.003 K 1.5, import-time load, compile/TF32 self-verified.

records.title: v5: v4 + manual CUDA graphs (plus other changes)
records.hypothesis: Manual CUDA graph capture cuts per-call latency.
records.method: torch.cuda.graph() capture bundled with four other changes; no top-level guard on _load_at_import().
records.results: live: all subscores 0, final 0.0000. Zip not present in the tree.
records.why: torch.randn after the capture left the CUDA RNG in capture mode and raised at import; with no outer guard the process died before serving a batch.
records.source: CAMPAIGN_REPORT.md §3 row 8 (L122), '#8, the zero' (L153-160); closed_directions.json C08

records.title: v6: v4 with bands x0.85, fp16 bounds, rank modifier retired
records.hypothesis: Bands were ~40% too wide for the FNO, so a x0.85 step gains SPS; fp16 bounds save time.
records.method: submission_fno_boosted_v6.zip: _BAND_SCALE=0.85 on A and K, _BAND_SHAPE=False (modifier 'RETIRED' in source), bounds returned as .half(), corrector eta 1.4, CUDA-graph path removed.
records.results: live: rel 94.020 tke 75.725 mvpe 92.807 time 91.139 sps 31.559 final 77.7459 (T 0.4623, 6.89 ms). vs v4: sps -0.990, time -0.267. No preflight output file.
records.why: The scale was already right, and the harness pays to widen fp16 bounds. Note: the build also turned the rank modifier off, which the ledger does not mention, so the -0.990 sps mixes two changes.
records.source: CAMPAIGN_REPORT.md §3 row 9 (L123), '#9' (L162-163), §6.1 (L297-307); zip submission.py L110-160 (_BAND_SCALE, _BAND_SHAPE=False), L649-650 (.half())
